content:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired — PD-INC-8843: ALB target health failures in us-west-2. Auto-page to on-call rotation. Severity=P1. Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-INC-8843

pagerduty: Alert: triggered: ALB health checks failing, >30% 502/524 responses observed by synthetic checks. Notified: Ana (oncall).

Ana (oncall): ACK. I'm looking. Pinging network and SRE. @Ben can you check ALB target group health?

Ben (network): on it. I'm seeing a burst of TLS handshake failures on ALB -> targets (SNI alert). Backend targets reporting `unhealthy` in target group. Grabbing target-health.

Ben (network): ```
$ aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:...:targetgroup/tg-api/abcd1234
{"TargetHealthDescriptions": [{"Target": {"Id": "i-0abcd1234"}, "TargetHealth": {"State": "unhealthy", "Reason": "Health checks failed"}}, {"Target": {"Id": "i-0efgh5678"}, "TargetHealth": {"State": "unhealthy", "Description": "TLS handshake failure"}}] }
```

pagerduty: ACK recorded — Ana (oncall). Escalation paused.

Cory (sre): joining. ops-bot shows no deploys in last hour, so likely infra or cert/cipher regression. Checking ALB logs for TLS errors and also kube-proxy logs on the targets.

Dana (support): customer reports: "/v1/generate returns 502 intermittently around 14:02-14:08 PST, affects ~3% of requests, mostly long prompt completions." Several enterprise customers flagged degraded SLA.

Ellie (product): noted impact on enterprise tier. How long estimate to restore to 99.9%?

Ben (network): quick mitigation — isolating and draining unhealthy targets from target group. Shifting 100% traffic to secondary target set in same region while we debug. Executing: `aws elbv2 deregister-targets` for the 2 problem instances.

Ben (network): After deregister: ALB health stable for remaining targets. Synthetic checks show error rate dropped from 4.2% -> 0.6% in ~90s. Still seeing retries from some client sessions.

Ana (oncall): Good. I'm going to add a short note to status page and update CS. Dana, please post an initial incident advisory to affected customers (short timeline + mitigation).

Dana (support): Will do. Drafting: "We experienced intermittent TLS/target health errors affecting request success; we have shifted traffic and are investigating root cause. Engineers are working; updates every 15m."

Cory (sre): Collected ALB access logs and backend logs. Observed repeated TLS alerts: `SSL3_GET_SERVER_CERTIFICATE:certificate verify failed` and `tls: handshake failure (remote error: unexpected_message)` from a subset of clients. But client-side TLS errors are small; more likely backend process or host network stack. ops-bot shows kernel updates applied to those hosts this morning (cron-kick).

ops-bot: Host maintenance snapshot: host i-0abcd1234 applied package updates: linux-image-5.15.0-202; rebooted at 03:12 UTC.

Ben (network): That matches the window. I'm opening a maintenance check w/ infra to see if the kernel/new cipher list change affected SNI behavior. Meanwhile we kept the unhealthy hosts drained.

Cory (sre): Temporary config mitigation: lower ALB target group healthy threshold from 4 -> 2 to reduce sensitivity while we confirm root cause. Also increased health check interval to 10s to avoid flapping. Changes applied.

Ben (network): Also pushed a weighted DNS change in Route53 to shift 100% traffic to the secondary ALB endpoint as an extra guard while we patch hosts. Command: ```
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z3EXAMPLE --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.redwood.ai","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"us-west-2-secondary","Weight":100,"TTL":60,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"52.12.34.56"}]}}]}'
```

Ana (oncall): Thanks. That should reduce blast radius. Any sign of config drift or secret/cert expiry?

Cory (sre): Checking certs: certs valid until 2026. Not an expiry. Cipher preferences on host might have changed with kernel update. We're rolling a temporary restart of the TLS stack on the drained hosts after patching.

Ben (network): Patch steps: cordon -> drain -> apply kernel fix/rollback or reconfigure cipher policy -> reboot -> register back. We'll register only after 3 successful health checks. ETA for first host ~18 minutes.

Dana (support): Posted customer advisory with mitigation note and asked customers to open tickets if they see continued errors. Received one reply from key customer noting decreased throughput for large completions; escalated to account team.

Ellie (product): Please tag me on the account thread. Also let's capture examples of failing requests for evals.

Cory (sre): After first host remediation: registered back, health passed. Error rate to synthetic probes back down to baseline (~0.1%). No new TLS handshakes failing.

Ben (network): Rolling through remaining hosts now. Ops team confirms kernel package reconfigured to include previous cipher ordering; we'll submit a kernel/package vendor follow-up.

Ana (oncall): Good work. Declaring incident mitigated for live customer impact at 15:06 UTC; continuing remediation as a post-mitigations task.

pagerduty: Incident status updated to: Mitigated by Ana (oncall). Close when RCA and postmortem ready.

Cory (sre): Follow-ups (RCA action items):
- Confirm kernel update introduced TLS stack behavior change on this image build.
- Add canary checks for host cipher suites prior to rolling updates.
- Update runbook: for ALB TLS handshake errors, prefer draining+route53-weighted failover before lowering health thresholds.
- Add alert that correlates package updates with subsequent target health flaps.

Ben (network): Ops action: pin auto-kernel-updates for critical target groups until we validate new image in canary.

Dana (support): Will send a customer follow-up summary w/ timeline and mitigation in next 2 hours.

Ellie (product): We'll schedule a postmortem sync with CS and Eng to review impact and comms.

Ana (oncall): Handing off to Cory for RCA & postmortem tracking. I'm off-call in 10. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

Cory (sre): Taking ownership of the post-incident tasks. Will add notes + timeline to the incident board and set a remedial ticket.

ops-bot: No deploys detected during incident window.

incident-bot: Thread closed for live mitigation. Move to postmortems once RCA completed.
